values.name: Pulse
values.text: One shared clock step. By default, one overworld turn plus one turn in every battle.

values.name: Planning
values.text: The step in which orders are drafted and forecast. About 60 s plus reserve.

values.name: Reserve
values.text: Banked planning time that tops up the per-turn budget.

values.name: Reveal
values.text: The moment all orders become visible, before the reaction window.

values.name: Reaction
values.text: A restricted order triggered by an interaction that revealed orders create.

values.name: Reaction window
values.text: The pause after Reveal in which reactions are issued.

values.name: Execute
values.text: Time-sliced simulated resolution of the turn.

values.name: Intermission
values.text: The step between turns. It holds summaries and Legend choices; 30 s cap, 10 s ranked.

values.name: Intent ghost
values.text: The preview of a planned order's path or effect.

values.name: Unit
values.text: One simulated model.

values.name: Squad
values.text: The command unit, a group of Units.

values.name: Leader
values.text: The Unit tagged `leader` that uses a squad's individual surge benefits.

values.name: Commander
values.text: The hero-like unit that anchors an army and owns reactions.

values.name: Army
values.text: Everything a Commander leads on the overworld.

values.name: Battleforce
values.text: The part of an army committed to one battle.

values.name: Drop-off
values.text: Committing a battleforce without the Commander staying.

values.name: Detachment / Convoy
values.text: Forces or items moving on the overworld without a Commander. Convoys on the same hex and supply line merge.

values.name: War Chest
values.text: An army's item inventory.

values.name: Archetype
values.text: A content template (parent plus overrides, at most 3 deep), flattened at load.

values.name: SIMPL
values.text: Stamina, Instinct, Morale, Prowess, Legend: the five squad-level pressure systems.

values.name: Stamina
values.text: Exertion capacity.

values.name: Instinct
values.text: Reaction and precision. It pays for Detection and Concealment.

values.name: Morale
values.text: The governor. The only channel between the other systems.

values.name: Prowess
values.text: Battlefield presence.

values.name: Legend
values.text: A squad's story pressure. Its Surges and Breaks leave persistent consequences.

values.name: Float / Sink
values.text: Add pressure to, or remove pressure from, a pool.

values.name: Vacuum
values.text: A pending sink, shown in forecasts. Also a zone's influence decay.

values.name: Bands
values.text: Surging 90–100%, Primed 65–89%, Neutral 40–64%, Fraying 15–39%, Broken below 15%.

values.name: Surge / Break
values.text: Crossing into Surging, or into Broken.

values.name: Drift
values.text: A pool's movement toward Neutral each tick.

values.name: Sensitivity profile
values.text: Data saying what moves a squad's pool and what the pool affects.

values.name: Pressure ledger
values.text: The per-battle, source-tagged record of every pressure flow.

values.name: FPDR
values.text: Fixed Point Defined Rounding, the deterministic arithmetic rule.

values.name: Accumulator
values.text: A deterministic counter that replaces chance: it counts an event (seconds, hits, distance, health lost, ...) and fires at a threshold.

values.name: Defensive Profile
values.text: The defence layers: Evasion, Block, Resistance, Flat, Percentage, Floor, Temporary HP, Absorption.

values.name: Evasion
values.text: Avoids a hit entirely.

values.name: Block
values.text: A percentage chance to block a percentage of a hit.

values.name: Floor
values.text: The minimum damage a hit can deal after reductions, per damage type. 0 means immunity is possible.

values.name: Temporary HP
values.text: Wards and shields that soak damage before Hit Points. They don't count toward HP-based thresholds.

values.name: Absorption
values.text: After taking damage of a type, a portion of it is restored as health.

values.name: Bad Hit
values.text: A hit greater than 50% of a unit's base HP.

values.name: Readying
values.text: Time spent before a separate behaviour becomes available.

values.name: Sight
values.text: A universal radius, limited by line of sight, that lifts fog.

values.name: Detection
values.text: An ability that reveals concealed squads within its radius.

values.name: Concealment
values.text: An ability that hides a squad from enemies without Detection.

values.name: Ambush
values.text: An attack begun while the target hasn't detected the attacker.

values.name: Intercept
values.text: A charge against an enemy squad that is itself charging one of yours.

values.name: Keyword
values.text: A static squad property.

values.name: Status
values.text: A transient bundle of effects on a unit or squad.

values.name: Effect
values.text: One change described in the effect language: operation, target, magnitude, condition, duration, stacking, tags, source.

values.name: Bundle
values.text: A named group of effects. Abilities, statuses, items and features are bundles.

values.name: Stat
values.text: A registered value effects can change. Systems read its effective value.

values.name: Increased
values.text: A percentage modifier summed with every other "increased" on the same stat before it applies.

values.name: More
values.text: A percentage modifier that multiplies on its own, after all "increased" modifiers.

values.name: Trace
values.text: The step-by-step calculation of an effective value, shown in the inspection window.

values.name: Stack
values.text: One count of a stacking effect; "per stack" magnitudes multiply by it.

values.name: Selector
values.text: Picks an effect's targets, ordered by distance then ID.

values.name: Hook
values.text: An effect that fires when an event happens, one level deep.

values.name: Tag
values.text: A registered label on effects, abilities, weapons and damage, used for selection, resistance, restriction, Ruin and Null.

values.name: Restores
values.text: An effect flag that refills current value when a maximum rises, instead of keeping the ratio.

values.name: Bank
values.text: Story-campaign data carried between campaigns.

values.name: Ability
values.text: A bundle plus an activation (costs, cooldown, charges, ready time, range, targeting, toggle).

values.name: Inspection window
values.text: The per-unit breakdown screen, available in planning and playback.

values.name: Zone
values.text: An area that accrues Influence for whoever holds it.

values.name: Capture Rate (CR)
values.text: How strongly a squad pushes a zone's influence. Human infantry has 10.

values.name: Influence
values.text: Zone progress, and one of the two scoring modes.

values.name: Buffer
values.text: Stored influence above the capture threshold that must be eroded before a zone can flip.

values.name: Value
values.text: The economic and scoring worth of forces. The sole resource.

values.name: Victory Points (VP)
values.text: Score from captured zones.

values.name: End-of-battle hook
values.text: Data deciding what happens to remaining forces when a battle ends.

values.name: Plot
values.text: One hex.

values.name: Feature
values.text: What a plot offers: production, recruitment, resources, events, garrisons.

values.name: Route
values.text: A Commander's planned hex path.

values.name: Quick action
values.text: Something done while passing along a route.

values.name: Activity
values.text: Something that requires ending the route on the hex.

values.name: Supply line
values.text: A production rally route carried by convoys.

values.name: Movement bank
values.text: 50% of unused movement kept when a plan is cut short.

values.name: The Law
values.text: First Magic. A magic operating system with a registry and audits.

values.name: Raw magic
values.text: The primal narrative force.

values.name: Second Magic
values.text: Illicit access to Law endpoints.

values.name: Ruin / Ruined
values.text: Law scoured beyond function. A zone condition.

values.name: Null
values.text: No magic at all.

values.name: Legivore
values.text: The magic-killer.

values.name: Angel
values.text: A lensed counterfactual, a "messenger from nonsense".

values.name: Angelfall
values.text: The planetary collapse Angels bring.

values.name: Lawbringer
values.text: An agent of the organisation sustaining the Law.

values.name: EoAT
values.text: The End of All Things, the era of the story.
